decision: Preserve the complete revision864 discovery before the additive repair installation in checkpoint11; use that independently restored durable checkpoint as the common base for the seven later finished-reader checkpoints.
preservation_conditions: Keep all previous checkpoint archives immutable and available locally for final file-by-file retention reconciliation.
Keep every new proof, observation, audit, stage, numbered receipt and cumulative save/status record in the live collection; do not rely on the common base to reintroduce later files.
Use the full current source and all seven current PDFs; inherited exact old image/PDF inputs remain self-contained.
Do not materialize later sibling container-history trees into the collection merely to accumulate redundant control inventories.
After a workspace loss, restore the newest durable checkpoint and retrieve any older archive needed for complete final retention from its existing saved identity.
